title: Franklin Street Properties Corp. to Announce Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Franklin Street Properties Corp. (the “Company” or “FSP”) (NYSE American: FSP), a real estate investment trust (REIT), announced today that it expects to release its results for the second quarter 2026 after the market closes on Tuesday, July 28, 2026. The Company will not be holding a conference call/webcast this quarter. This press release, along with other news about FSP, is available on the Internet at www.fspreit.com . We routinely post information that may be important to investors in the Investor Relations section of our website. We encourage investors to consult that section of our website regularly for important information about us and, if they are interested in automatically receiving news and information as soon as it is posted, to sign up for E-mail Alerts.
